- **Area:** interface; **kind:** read; **lens:** planned change (#336 Step 1), security

The exact list is `tools/renovation-inventory --order`'s membership of `es-launch-path`.
- **Provenance tiers:** fork-own 17, upstream-carried 3
- **Read before:** #336 Step 1 (a reading order; the renovation gates no release, D-WORKFLOW-187)
- **Review depth:** Extended -- launch path (plan § 6c)
